name: protein A (RdRp)
note: RNA1 replicase, 1033-1045 aa. A methyltransferase and the RdRp separated by a predicted transmembrane region, from a structural model only.

name: B2
note: 131-133 aa, overlapping the 3' end of protein A in a shifted frame. NO subgenomic RNA has been demonstrated for MrNV, PvNV or CMNV, and RNAi-suppressor activity has NOT been shown for any of the three, so the annotation claims neither.

name: capsid protein
note: 371 aa in MrNV, 368 in PvNV, 437 in CMNV. A single uncleaved chain with dimeric P-domain spikes, unlike the trimeric spikes of alpha- and betanodaviruses, and with NO gamma peptide.

name: B1
note: DELIBERATELY ABSENT. No B1 is documented for MrNV, PvNV or CMNV and none is annotated in NC_005094.1, NC_014978.1 or MT270124.1. Its absence is the single gene that separates this module from Betanodavirus, so ABSENT here is the expected and required result.

name: capsid maturation cleavage product
note: DELIBERATELY ABSENT. The one reported MrNV capsid cleavage, at Arg26, was produced by an E. coli cysteine protease in recombinant protein and is blocked by E-64 -- a heterologous-expression artefact, not viral maturation. The virion capsid is a single 43 kDa polypeptide (PMID 15660790).
